input.question: Which sports team does Sascha Lense represent or represent?

documents.text: As the sun dipped behind the rugged mountains of Tajikistan, the streets of Dushanbe came alive with the hum of anticipation. The city's football enthusiasts were abuzz with excitement, for tonight was the night CSKA Pomir Dushanbe would take on their arch-rivals, FC Istiklol, in the highly anticipated Tajikistan Higher League match. In the midst of the bustling streets, a tall, lanky figure emerged from the shadows of the team's hotel. Sascha Lense, the German footballer with a reputation for his lightning-quick reflexes and uncanny ability to read the game, stretched his long legs as he made his way to the team bus. His piercing blue eyes, a trait that had earned him the nickname "The Berlin Bullet" back in his Bundesliga days, scanned the crowded sidewalks, taking in the sea of CSKA Pomir Dushanbe's red and blue jerseys. As he boarded the bus, Sascha was greeted by the warm smile of his teammate, Rustam Khodzhaev, who was busy strumming a traditional Tajik dutor to get the team in the right mindset. The bus driver, a grizzled old man named Akbar, gave Sascha a hearty clap on the back, saying, "Tonight, we make the people of Dushanbe proud, yes?" The team's coach, a wise and battle-hardened veteran named Vladimir, stood up to address the players. "Tonight, we face our toughest opponent yet. But I have faith in each and every one of you. Sascha, your experience will be crucial in the midfield. Rustam, your speed will be the key to unlocking their defense. Let us go out there and show them what CSKA Pomir Dushanbe is capable of!" As the bus wound its way through the crowded streets, Sascha gazed out the window, taking in the vibrant colors and sounds of the city. He had never imagined that his football career would take him to this corner of the world, but he was grateful for the opportunity to play for CSKA Pomir Dushanbe. There was something about the passion and dedication of the Tajik people that resonated deeply with him. As the team arrived at the Central Republican Stadium, the energy in the air was palpable. Sascha could feel the weight of expectation on his shoulders, but he was ready.
